The period between the date of relieving and the date of joining Public Sector Undertaking/ Autonomous Body can be regulated as leave of the kind due and admissible and if no leave is due, by grant of extraordinary leave. In case he/she is not able to join the Public Sector Undertaking/ Autonomous Body within the period allowed by the competent authority, he/she should report back to the parent office forthwith.
